title: Practically
summary: PRAC'TICALLY, adverb In relation to practice. 1. By means of practice or use; by experiment; as practically wise or skillful. 2. In practice or use; as a medicine practically safe; theoretically wrong

inlines.v: PRAC'TICALLY, adverb In relation to practice. 1. By means of practice or use; by experiment; as practically wise or skillful. 2. In practice or use; as a medicine practically safe; theoretically wrong, but practically right.
